card.name: Verb after a place or person subject
card.fires_on: The verb or auxiliary right after a subject that is a named place, institution, or historical person, mostly in encyclopedic history text. Often it is 'could' or 'can' before a statement of capacity or ability.

modes.label: Could/can of capacity
modes.description: The modal 'could' or 'can' after an institution, place or person, introducing what it was able to hold or do.
modes.example: in Cairo for example, the Qalawun Hospital<< could>> care for 8,000

modes.label: Other verbs after the subject
modes.description: A verb or auxiliary such as 'talked', 'lacks', 'were' or 'visible' placed after a place or thing subject in a descriptive sentence.
modes.example: The national party headquarters<< lacks>> the power to orchestrate activities at the
